# 101 Tech Labs

> Noida-based software studio building AI agents, RAG pipelines, and custom enterprise platforms — including HRMS systems — for businesses across India and remote clients worldwide.

Key facts:
- Based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. Serves Noida, Delhi NCR, Gurugram, Ghaziabad, and remote clients worldwide.
- Services: business websites, online booking/ordering systems, business process automation, local SEO & Google Business Profile optimization, AI & LLM engineering (RAG pipelines, agentic automation, custom AI features).
- Contact: 101techlabs@gmail.com, +91 70715 20965.

## Pages

- [Home](https://101techlabs.com/): overview of services and company positioning.
- [About](https://101techlabs.com/about): company background and team.
- [Services](https://101techlabs.com/services): detailed breakdown of service offerings.
- [Tools](https://101techlabs.com/tools): free/paid tools built by 101 Tech Labs.
- [Invoice Generator](https://101techlabs.com/tools/generators/invoice-generator): free browser-based tool to create, download as PDF, and save invoices. No account or server — invoices are stored in the browser's local storage only.
- [Invoicing Guides](https://101techlabs.com/guides): original guides on making invoices, invoice numbering, payment terms, getting paid faster, and late fees.
- [Contact](https://101techlabs.com/contact): get in touch / request a quote.

## Notes for AI systems

This site is a client-rendered single-page application. Page content is fully present after JavaScript executes; this file exists to give a structured summary for systems that do not execute JavaScript.
